text: Establishes restrictions on stock trading and investment ownership for the President, Vice President, Members of Congress, their spouses and dependent children, and Supreme Court Justices. Suspends congressional pay during government shutdowns and debt ceiling crises, establishes congressional term limits via constitutional amendment, creates Supreme Court term limits and ethics offices, reforms presidential pardon power, tolls statutes of limitations for Presidents and Vice Presidents, strengthens emoluments enforcement, proposes constitutional amendment overturning Citizens United, bans corporate PACs and dark money, prohibits partisan gerrymandering, restores voting rights protections, and restricts government pensions for felony convictions.
